setup.text: A weaver wants to decorate clothing with a design copied from spiderwebs.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The new garment becomes admired for its intricate lines.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The delicate threads snag, and the weaver revises the design.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The garment honors a family tradition.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The weaver wishes the pattern reflected more of their own imagination.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The new pattern links family history with the forest.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some villagers cannot tell which parts are old and which are new.
